description: This file defines interfaces, notifiers, and data structures for the RLC (Radio Link Control) entity in a wireless communication protocol stack, specifically for the transmit (tx) side. It includes definitions for SDU handling, upper and lower layer interfaces, and buffer state management.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_data_interface
classes.description: Interface for upper layers to pass SDUs into the RLC transmit entity and to discard SDUs.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_data_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for upper layer to receive transmission and delivery status updates of SDUs.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_upper_layer_control_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for protocol errors or maximum retransmission events in the RLC transmit side.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_lower_layer_interface
classes.description: Interface for lower layers to pull PDUs from the RLC transmit entity and query buffer state.

classes.name: ocudu::rlc_tx_lower_layer_notifier
classes.description: Notifier for RLC to inform lower layers about buffer state updates.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs from upper layers for transmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards SDUs identified by PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: on_transmitted_sdu
methods.description: Informs upper layer of transmitted SDUs.

methods.name: on_delivered_sdu
methods.description: Informs upper layer of successfully delivered SDUs.

methods.name: on_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Informs upper layer of retransmitted SDUs.

methods.name: on_delivered_retransmitted_sdu
methods.description: Informs upper layer of delivered retransmitted SDUs.

methods.name: on_protocol_failure
methods.description: Notifies upper layer of protocol failure.

methods.name: on_max_retx
methods.description: Notifies upper layer that maximum retransmissions have been reached.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Pulls a PDU from the lower layer for transmission.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns current buffer state including size and HOL TOA.

methods.name: on_buffer_state_update
methods.description: Updates lower layer with current buffer state.
